name: Last One Standing
description: Everyone writes four facts; the room stands and each fact thins the crowd. Last one up wrote the card.

instructions.message:
Last One Standing

You'll write four facts about yourself. Then we play one card at a time: the whole room stands up, and each fact knocks people back into their seats. Whoever is left standing at the end wrote the card.

Fact 1: something common, true of many people here.
Fact 2: a little more specific or distinctive.
Fact 3: something unusual, interesting, or personal.
Fact 4: true of only you, or very few of us.

Tip: skip job titles and resume facts. Hobbies, adventures, and funny stories work best.

write.prompt: Your four facts, from 'lots of us' to 'only me'. Example: I enjoy podcasts. I have 9 siblings. I played college soccer. I have been to Space Camp twice.

fields.label: Fact 1: common, many people here might say this too
Fact 2: a little more specific or distinctive

ready.message:
Cards are in!

Here's how it works: when a card's fact is NOT true of you, sit down. Stay standing as long as the card keeps describing you.

Devices down, eyes up. Let's meet each other.

fact-one.message:
New card! Everyone stand up.

Stay standing if this is true of you:

“{{_current.fields.fact1}}”

fact-two.message:
Keep standing only if this is you too:

“{{_current.fields.fact2}}”

fact-four.message:
Last fact. If this is not you, take a seat:

“{{_current.fields.fact4}}”

the-owner.message:
Whoever is still standing wrote this card...

It's {{_current.playerName}}!

Tell us the story behind that last fact.

common-ground.instruction: These are icebreaker cards from one group of colleagues. Each card has four parts separated by ' | ', ordered from a common fact to a one-of-a-kind fact. Find what this group shares: recurring themes, overlapping hobbies or experiences, and one or two delightful surprises. Return a warm 3-4 sentence summary of what this room has in common, written to be read aloud.
